verdict.rationale: The SDK offers session memory across turns and a resumable RunState for human-in-the-loop pauses, and community evidence mentions a Temporal-based durable-execution version of the SDK, suggesting integration paths exist. However there is no first-party documentation of native durability across process restarts/deploys, nor detailed docs on the Temporal (or other durable-execution) integration itself. Missing for 10: first-party docs on native crash/restart recovery, official durable-execution integration guide (e.g., Temporal), and evidence of production-grade long-running agent state persistence.
